title: Property
description: Real estate property listing with type, location, pricing, specifications (bedrooms, bathrooms, area), year built, features, and images. Used for property rental platforms, real estate marketplaces, and accommodation booking systems.

description.description: Detailed description of the property, amenities, and features

type.description: Property type (e.g., Apartment, House, Villa, Condo, Studio)

status.description: Property status (e.g., available, rented, sold, under_maintenance)

city.description: City where the property is located

state.description: State or province where the property is located

country.description: Country where the property is located

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the property

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the property

price.description: Property price (sale) or rental rate per period

currency.description: ISO currency code for the price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

year_built.description: Year when the property was built

features.description: Array of property features (e.g., WiFi, Parking, Pool, Garden, Air Conditioning)

image.description: URL to the property's main image
